tools.name: list_competitor_moves
tools.description: Use when the user asks what a specific competitor has recently done or changed. Returns recent tracked strategic moves for one competitor, newest-first — the existence of each shift plus a was→now summary and the real analysis date (never a fabricated date). Returns { covered: false } for companies

tools.name: find_competitors
tools.description: Use when the user asks who else competes in a company's market, or wants a peer/competitor set for a given company. Given a company domain or name, returns the other companies IndustryLens tracks in the same market. Returns { covered: false } for companies not publicly tracked.

tools.name: list_reports
tools.description: Use when the user wants to browse or discover published competitive-intelligence reports (e.g. by topic, role, or industry) rather than fetch one specific report by slug. tools.description: Use ONLY after the user explicitly asks to subscribe to IndustryLens's weekly intelligence-report newsletter — never subscribe an email without their direct, informed consent. Signs the given email up and returns a confirmation. The source argument is recorded for attribution and defaults to 'mcp'.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_reports, get_report, list_comparisons, get_competitor_moves_diff, get_pricing_changes, get_market_landscape · Public sink: subscribe_to_newsletter.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_reports, get_report, list_comparisons, get_competitor_moves_diff, get_pricing_changes, get_market_landscape · Public sink: subscribe_to_newsletter

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
